name: return32-foreign-ltcg-declared
description: P68 foreign long-term gain DECLARED: 8,000,000 foreign units at 80/USD = 100,000, all long-term, with 800,000 units (10,000) of foreign tax. Lands on Sch D Part II and is taxed preferentially; Form 1116 §904(b)(2)(B) scales it.
note: Hand-verified: AGI 220,000; taxable 190,000. QDCGT ordinary 90,000 -> 11,400; preferential 100,000 with 6,000 in the 0% band and 94,000 x 15%=14,100 -> tax 25,500. FTC limit = 25,500 x (40,541/190,000) = 5,441 < 10,000 paid. Liability 20,059; wh 20,000 -> owe 59. PLACEHOLDER rules. §904(b)(2)(B)(ii) CORRECTION: the rate-differential adjustment applies to ENTIRE taxable income (Form 1116 line 18) as well as to foreign-source income, and the kernel previously scaled only the numerator. HAND-VERIFIED on return27: adjusted foreign-source = 50,000 x 15/37 = 20,270; the reduction to worldwide = 50,000 - 20,270 = 29,730, so line 18 = 135,000 - 29,730 = 105,270; limitation = 22,000 x 20,270/105,270 = 4,236 (was 3,303 on the unadjusted 135,000). Independently confirmed against a professionally prepared return whose Form 1116 line 18 was 239,975 against taxable income of 295,678 - a reduction of exactly (net capital gain + qualified dividends) x (1 - 15/37). The credit rises in every affected golden and stays at or below foreign tax paid. FORM 1116 PART I: deductions are now apportioned against foreign-source income (lines 3 and 4), which was not modelled at all. HAND-VERIFIED on return27, which takes the STANDARD deduction so it lands whole on line 3a: 3a 15,000; 3d gross foreign 50,000; 3e gross income from all sources 150,000; 3f 0.33333; 3g 5,000; line 1a 50,000 x 15/37 = 20,270; line 7 = 20,270 - 5,000 = 15,270; line 18 = 105,270; limitation = 22,000 x 15,270/105,270 = 3,191. The kernel independently produced 3,191. Verified line-for-line against a professionally prepared Form 1116 whose 3a was 17,144 (SALT 28,337 less state income tax withheld 11,193 - state INCOME tax is definitely related and is NOT apportioned), 3e 371,473 (total income plus 42,410 of carryovers and a 395 short-term loss added back, because line 3e is GROSS), 3f 0.2874, 3g 4,927 and 4a 1,053 (mortgage interest at the same ratio). Credits FALL here, as they must: apportioned deductions shrink the numerator.
